theory: The intro and procedure present tariff-based invoice construction as the skill's main task, but the supplied section teaches reading bills, comparing successive bills, calculating daily household water use and checking household efficiency targets. Align the theory and procedure with those supported tasks; meter-reading subtraction, gas volume-to-energy conversion, daily supply calculations and tiered invoice methods are unsupported here. Do not repeat Purchasing goods' erroneous claim that electricity and gas are GST-free: the attached electricity invoice explicitly charges GST, while the residential water invoice states that GST does not apply.
